displayDescription: Ransom-note headline, torn paper and a Rough.js ink network pasted onto cool grey graph paper; the CONNECTED stamp is the punchline.
styleRenderer: Rough.js 4.6.6 (seeded rough.svg lines, circles, curve; bundled locally with esbuild to rough.bundle.js)
Pillow 10.3 preprocessing (torn-paper masks, halftone sheet, graph paper, paper/tape textures, stamp distress)
HTML/CSS DOM cutout tiles and paper layers
motionEngine: GSAP 3 paused timeline registered at window.__timelines.video (sole owner of transforms, opacity, stroke-dashoffset and HUD time proxy)
audioDescription: Silent preview. No soundtrack, voice or sound effects were created.
limitations: Paper, tape, halftone and stamp distress are procedural 2D approximations baked by Pillow; there is no physical paper simulation, real photocopy process or real tearing.
Paste and slap actions are rigid 2D transforms; nothing peels or folds in 3D.
Fonts are macOS system faces (Impact, Georgia, Didot, Rockwell, Futura, American Typewriter, Courier New, Marker Felt, Menlo) with generic fallbacks; other systems may substitute them.
The headline copy was corrected from 'A IDEA TURNS' in the illustration to 'AN IDEA TURNS'.
The source-frame review covers sampled stills from one reference; motion timing between those samples was inferred, not observed.
No preview_recipes are defined in STYLE.json, so this preview demonstrates the primary style refreshed from the source-frame evidence.
